game.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands
game.blurb: Open-world tactical shooter from Ubisoft (RAWG lists Ubisoft Montpellier, Bucharest, Annecy, Paris, Milan and Reflections), released 2017-03-06. RAWG average playtime: 18 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Massively Multiplayer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The first mission, the first boss, the Smuggling, Production, Security and Influence operations, all Story missions and the ending.

chapters.title: Exploring the Open World
chapters.summary: Skydiving, driving, interrogations, legends, side missions and convoys.

chapters.title: Documents, Medals and Weapons
chapters.summary: Finding documents and bonus medals and collecting every weapon model.

chapters.title: Skills, Rebels and Levels
chapters.summary: Skill upgrades, drone upgrades, Rebel skills and maxing out XP.

chapters.title: Combat Tricks
chapters.summary: Long shots, drones, C4, mines, mortars and night-time close combat.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Missions and kills with another player.

chapters.title: Operation Narco Road
chapters.summary: The Narco Road expansion: its bosses, final target, followers and trials.

chapters.title: Fallen Ghosts
chapters.summary: The Fallen Ghosts expansion: its Extranjeros enemies, Rebel Ops, the Flash Drone and explosive bolts.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands", "Ghost Recon Wildlands" or "Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands". ghostrecon.fandom.com answers the API under "Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands" with about 91 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 57 Steam achievements is hidden. The two expansion chapters take their names from the achievement descriptions ("Operation Narco Road" and "Fallen Ghosts"); those 14 achievements are all below 2%. Only two achievements name another player, so the co-op chapter is small.
